recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14509 unless OO later reopens the broader policy question about prescribing one Observation code/value pattern across all implementations.
issue_request: The Published STU3 Observation issue asked for more prescriptive rules among the four Observation.code/Observation.value patterns; OO resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, deciding that base FHIR should not prescribe one pattern for all implementations and should instead add text saying specific pattern choices belong in profiles and implementation guides defined by jurisdictions or organizations.
initial_application: Git commit d06b52856c89401a981241a811faa7b455037c08 explicitly mentions GF#14509 and added the approved profile/implementation-guide guidance to source/observation/observation-notes.xml. The current source retains the intended wording, with later typo/editorial corrections.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Observation, so source/observation/observation-notes.xml is current build-scope narrative source. OO minutes from 2018-02-23 corroborate the Jira disposition and 10-0-2 vote. Later same-section issues FHIR-39188 and FHIR-15526 are already represented on the combined branch and do not supersede the FHIR-14509 guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active Observation notes already say that, because Observation supports many use cases, the appropriate place to define the specific pattern is through profiles and implementation guides specified by jurisdictions and/or organizations implementing FHIR.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied R6 issue restored/replaced case 4 presence/absence guidance in the same Observation pattern section; it is already represented on the combined branch.
